questions.topic: PrepLadder · 23.Primary Immunodeficiency and Vasculitis in Children
questions.stem: A 6-month-old male infant presents with recurrent bacterial infections, including otitis media and pneumonia. Laboratory tests reveal very low levels of immunoglobulins (IgG, IgA, and IgM) and an absence of B cells (CD19+ cells) in the peripheral blood. What is the most likely diagnosis?
